chapter.title: Patterns with Threads
chapter.tagline: Discovering nature's weavers, spinning cotton on charkhas, and weaving Pochampally textiles
chapter.overview: Spiders, weaver birds, and silkworms were weaving long before humans ever made clothes. Students examine plant fibres (cotton, jute) and animal fibres (silk, wool), trace the path from fluffy cotton pod to spun yarn on the charkha, and celebrate the heritage of Pochampally handlooms.

storyNarrative.dialogue: In our Pochampally village, we tie and dye the silk threads in intricate geometric patterns before placing them on the pit loom. Clack-clack goes the shuttle!
